description: The plot titled “Whisper fine-tunning, type = tiny” shows how the metric WER changes across training epochs for five fine-tuning/quantization variants. The x-axis is labeled “epoch,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at every 1 epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 20 up to 70, with labeled ticks at 30, 40, 50, 60, and 70. The “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” series is drawn as a gray solid line with circular markers, decreasing from about 69 at epoch 0 to about 36–37 at epoch 6, with intermediate points near 60 (epoch 1), 55 (epoch 2), 45 (epoch 3), and 40 (epoch 4). The “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” series is a gray solid line with square markers, moving from about 60 at epoch 0 down to about 32 at epoch 6, passing through approximately 51 (epoch 1), 51 (epoch 2), 43 (epoch 3), 37–38 (epoch 4), and 35–36 (epoch 5). The “tiny int4” series is a gray dashed line with circular markers, dropping from about 68–69 at epoch 0 to about 40 at epoch 6, with values around 55 (epoch 1), 49–50 (epoch 2), 44 (epoch 3), 39–40 (epoch 4), and about 39 (epoch 5). The “tiny int8” series is a gray dashed line with square markers, decreasing from about 60 at epoch 0 to about 37 at epoch 6, with points near 46–47 (epoch 1), 46 (epoch 2), 43 (epoch 3), 39 (epoch 4), and 37–38 (epoch 5). The “tiny full” series is a gray dotted line with triangular markers, starting near 29 at epoch 0 and ending near 23 at epoch 6, with intermediate values around 27 (epoch 1), 27 (epoch 2), 24 (epoch 3), 24 (epoch 4), and about 23–24 (epoch 5); the legend appears in the upper-right of the plotting area.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the performance of different fine-tuning methods over several epochs, represented by the metric 'WER' (Word Error Rate) on the y-axis. The x-axis is labeled 'epoch,' with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with integer tick labels for each epoch. The y-axis is labeled 'WER,' with a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70, marked at intervals of 10. The line marked with circular markers and a solid line style is color-coded in gray, representing 'tiny AdaLoRA_int4.' It starts at approximately 70 WER at epoch 0 and decreases to around 40 at epoch 6, showing a general downward trend. The line with square markers and a solid style represents 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' and follows a similar pattern, starting around 60 WER and ending below 35. The dashed line with circular markers represents 'tiny int4,' starting approximately 70 and decreasing to below 45 by epoch 6. The line with square markers and a dashed style, coded as 'tiny int8,' begins at 60, declining steadily to reach 40 at the end. Finally, the line with triangular markers and a dotted style indicates 'tiny full,' starting just below 30 and showing a slight downward trend, ending near 28 at epoch 6. Overall, the plot highlights the trajectory of WER across epochs for each method, with 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' consistently outperforming 'tiny full' across all epochs. A legend is placed at the top right corner of the plot.
